relationships.evidence_quote: Of the 102 (80-121) Grpr+ cells identified, we found that 36% (35%-38%) were also positive for Tac1 mRNA.

key_findings: Grpr-expressing cells in the mouse superficial dorsal horn are glutamatergic vertical cells (~15% of excitatory neurons in laminae I-II) that synapse onto each other and largely separate from other excitatory peptide populations, with ~1/3 overlap with Tac1.
Most GRPR cells receive monosynaptic Trpv1 afferent input, respond to noxious and pruritic stimuli, and their chemogenetic activation evokes both pain- and itch-related behaviours.
